# Meridian Dynamics

> Meridian Dynamics is a digital studio helping modern businesses build a stronger digital presence through strategy, website design and development, digital products, web engineering, and growth-related services.

## About

Meridian Dynamics brings digital design, technology, and growth together. Its approach emphasizes understanding a business's goals before recommending a tailored scope of work.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.meridiandynamics.online/): Overview of the studio and its approach.
- [Selected Work](https://www.meridiandynamics.online/work.html): Portfolio examples of digital products and websites.
- [Philosophy](https://www.meridiandynamics.online/philosophy.html): The principles behind the studio's approach.
- [About](https://www.meridiandynamics.online/about.html): Background, story, and beliefs of Meridian Dynamics.

## Capabilities

- Website design and development
- Digital products and web engineering
- Local search visibility and Google Business Profile support
- Analytics and conversion tracking, where included in the agreed scope
- Social media and content work, scoped to the client's goals and requirements

The appropriate services and deliverables depend on each client's needs. Do not assume that any fixed plan, price, outcome, or deliverable is universal; confirm current details directly with Meridian Dynamics.
